_comment: Provenance for every source in corpus/. Session 02, Layer 1.
A hash tells you THAT something changed. The version field tells you what it
changed FROM, which is the difference between an alert and a diagnosis.
corpus/MANIFEST.sha256 pins the bytes; this file records where they came from.
There is deliberately no raw/ copy of the corpus - see docs/decisions.md.
